clue_pairs.clue: I was a chief man among the brethren.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 15:22: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

clue_pairs.clue: I travelled with Paul after he parted from Barnabas.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 15:40: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

clue_pairs.clue: I was beaten and put in the stocks with Paul at Philippi.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 16:22-24: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them. And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

clue_pairs.clue: At midnight Paul and I prayed and sang praises.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 16:25: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

explanation: At midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God.
ref_kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

clue_pairs.clue: I was a Jew born at Alexandria.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 18:24: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

clue_pairs.clue: I was an eloquent man, mighty in the scriptures.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 18:24: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

clue_pairs.clue: Aquila and Priscilla taught me the way of God more perfectly.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Acts 18:26: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

clue_pairs.clue: Paul wrote that he planted and I watered.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: 1 Corinthians 3:6: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

explanation: A Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, was an eloquent man, mighty in the scriptures.
ref_kjv: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

clue_pairs.clue: My husband Nabal was churlish.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: 1 Samuel 25:3: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

clue_pairs.clue: I brought bread, wine and figs to David's men.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: 1 Samuel 25:18: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

clue_pairs.clue: I persuaded David not to shed blood.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: 1 Samuel 25:33: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

clue_pairs.clue: After Nabal died, I became David's wife.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: 1 Samuel 25:39-42: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife. And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife. And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord. And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

explanation: The man's name was Nabal and the name of his wife Abigail.
ref_kjv: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

clue_pairs.clue: I was king in Judaea when Jesus was born.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Matthew 2:1: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

clue_pairs.clue: I was troubled when wise men asked for the King of the Jews.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Matthew 2:3: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

clue_pairs.clue: I told the wise men to bring me word again.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Matthew 2:8: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

clue_pairs.clue: I ordered the children in Bethlehem slain.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Matthew 2:16: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

explanation: Herod sent forth and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem.
ref_kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

clue_pairs.clue: I was the wife of Heber the Kenite.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 4:17: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

clue_pairs.clue: Sisera fled to my tent.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 4:17: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

clue_pairs.clue: I gave him milk when he asked for water.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 4:19: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

clue_pairs.clue: I drove a nail of the tent into his temples.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 4:21: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

explanation: Jael, Heber's wife, took a nail of the tent and smote it into Sisera's temples.
ref_kjv: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

clue_pairs.clue: I lived in the valley of Sorek.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 16:4: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

clue_pairs.clue: The lords of the Philistines offered me silver.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 16:5: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

clue_pairs.clue: I asked a strong man the secret of his strength.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 16:6: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

clue_pairs.clue: I had his seven locks shaved while he slept.
clue_pairs.kjv_text: Judges 16:19: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

explanation: Samson loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
ref_kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
